name: reversed view into reshape [::-1, ::-1]
morf:
import tensor_basics/latest as tensor
accept Tensor[4,6] $x
$x[::-1, ::-1] >> tensor.reshape(shape="[24]") >> emit

name: reversed view into reshape [:, -1:-7:-2]
morf:
import tensor_basics/latest as tensor
accept Tensor[4,6] $x
$x[:, -1:-7:-2] >> tensor.reshape(shape="[12]") >> emit
